title: A mark or a body?
hook: Two fossils preserve different kinds of evidence.

doesNotKnow: A fossil footprint is a trace of an animal’s activity; a fossil bone represents a body part. A footprint can suggest movement but does not disclose every detail of its maker.

misconception: All evidence is the same kind.
objective: Distinguish evidence of activity from evidence of body parts.

claims.text: A fossil bone and a fossil footprint are found. Which one is a trace of an animal’s activity? A fossil footprint is a trace of an animal’s activity; a fossil bone represents a body part. A footprint can suggest movement but does not disclose every detail of its maker.
